leads.compliance: Data comes from public LinkedIn profiles and is used only for B2B outreach. Profiles are deleted 12 months after the last collection, or immediately on request. Staff send messages themselves — nothing is sent automatically.
leads.productHint: Use English (e.g. roasted cashews) to match international LinkedIn profiles; AI also uses it to score fit and write the note
leads.productPh: e.g. roasted cashews, robusta coffee, dried dragon fruit
leads.extraHint: Narrow results, e.g. food importer, wholesale, grocery, foodservice
leads.searchHint: Searches public LinkedIn profiles on the selected market’s Google. With few results it widens automatically: no quotes, then by trade (importer, distributor, wholesale). About $0.002–0.009 per search; full profiles are only fetched when you click Fetch profiles.
leads.noResults: No matching profiles even after widening — try fewer titles, other extra keywords (e.g. nuts, snacks, dried fruit) or another market.
leads.pasteHint: One linkedin.com/in/… link per line, up to {max} per run
